implementation_basis: docs/js/prisma.js:95 defines the active reviewer schema.

missing_capabilities: A visual evidence modality distinct from text snippets.
A stable asset reference carrying file identity or checksum.
A locator binding each asset to PDF page 13, Table 3, its Image 1–5 label, and the corresponding Table 2 command and AI-system entry.
A grouping relation preserving the five source images as one table-level visual evidence unit.
A reading-surface representation that retains the source images and their semantic table context.
assessment.basis: The present PRISM evidence object can bind selected text to a category and work version, but it has no fields for visual assets or visual locators. Its Markdown renderer cannot preserve the five image assets and Table 2-to-Table 3 relationships documented in the visual-evidence manifest.

out_of_scope: No category assignment or substantive screening decision was made from the images.
No source PDF, source Markdown, or PRISM implementation file was changed.
